title: Algo Trading Tradingview
author: KareemQamhawi
selftext:
Hey guys   
Im new to all this algo trading and i need some help   
Im a futures prop firm trader   
My biggest problem is discipline and revenge trading so i want to give algo trading a shot   
I trade manually on tradingview and i can turn any strategy into a bot   
My question is   
How can i talk to claude or any other llm to get the best results on a backtest   
What prompts u guys use what strategies works best with claude   
Hope you got the idea of what im looking for

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: Using Claude to write Pine Script for backtests is doable but you'll fight it constantly on logic errors and overfitting to the lookback period. Better approach: give it a clear framework (entry condition, stop, target, risk per trade) and have it code that specific logic, not generate strategies from scratch. For stocks rather than futures, trademates.co does the opposite  -  fixed structured output (recommendation, risk class, scenarios) instead of free-form LLM chat. https://trademates.co  -  US equities only, not futures or options. What timeframe are you trying to automate?

replies.author: KareemQamhawi
replies.body:
I can slove the overfitting issue as i have a a premium plan on tv i can backtest each month and not just last7/30/60/90/365 days 

I didnt get the part of giving a clear framework   
For example manually i use ict concepts as a strategy   
How can i combine that with claude

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: You'll get better results if you give Claude a specific entry condition, stop loss, target, and risk per trade rather than asking it to invent a strategy. For ICT concepts, break it down into concrete rules: "enter long when price breaks above the previous day's high after a fair value gap forms, stop at the low of the gap, target 2x risk." Then have Claude code that exact logic in Pine Script. Test month by month using TradingView's premium backtesting to spot overfitting.
